bug_info.bug_desc: The FSM advances immediately after sampling a valid ADC datum without waiting for adc_d_val_i to be deasserted. In the old code, ONEST_021 unconditionally moves to ONEST_1, LP_021 to LP_1, NP_021 to NP_1, LP_EVAL to LP_SLP/NP_0, and NP_EVAL to NP_0. If adc_d_val_i remains asserted for more than one cycle, the same ADC sample can be mistaken for a subsequent channel sample or evaluation trigger, causing incorrect channel values, incorrect sample counts, or premature mode transitions.
bug_info.fix_hint: Gate each forward FSM transition on the deassertion of adc_d_val_i: hold in the current channel-transition/evaluation state while adc_d_val_i is high, and only move to the next state once it is low. This enforces a complete four-phase handshake and prevents the same valid sample from being sampled again.
